summary: Tested Super Admin panel upgrades: search/country filter on Saloni tab, 'Panel >' navigation to tenant admin, Super Admin banner with 'Nazad na Super Panel' link, and regular admin not seeing the banner. All 18 assertions across 15 listed scenarios PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdminPage.jsx:165-180 - filteredTenants useMemo correctly handles search across name/slug/city/owner_email and country filter combined. Defensive default `t.country || 'RS'` is appropriate for legacy tenants without country.

SuperAdminPage.jsx:260-266 - 'Panel >' uses plain <a href> tag instead of react-router Link. This causes a full-page reload preserving auth via httpOnly cookie + localStorage token, so it still works, but a <Link to=...> would be smoother (no white flash). Same applies to AdminDashboard.jsx:73 back-link.

AdminDashboard.jsx:44-51 - handleLogout redirects super_admin to /login but uses navigate without { replace: true }; minor UX nit (back button can re-enter authenticated route briefly). Not a blocker.
AdminDashboard.jsx:53,68 - isSuperAdminViewing flag drives banner correctly; verified regular admin does NOT render the banner DOM (count = 0). Good.
SuperAdminPage.jsx:18-24 - Duplicated role guard alongside ProtectedSuperAdmin in App.js (noted in iteration_32 too). Redundant but harmless.
SuperAdminPage.jsx file size 392 lines is acceptable; if it grows further, SystemConfigPanel and the Create Salon modal could be extracted to separate files.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing tenants (Beauty Studio Bor, Beauty and Spa Mila, both RS).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin Saloni tab now has live search + country filter above the salon list (data-testid='salon-search-input', 'salon-country-filter'). Count label switches between 'X registrovanih salona' (unfiltered) and 'X od Y salona' (filtered). Empty filter result shows 'Nema rezultata za zadati filter.' Each salon row has a 'Panel >' bordered link (data-testid=`salon-link-{tenant_id}`) that navigates to /{slug}/admin. When super_admin views any tenant admin, a banner at top (data-testid='super-admin-banner') shows 'Pregledate salon kao Super Admin' with link data-testid='back-to-super-panel-link' to /super-admin. Regular admin sees no banner. All sidebar items (Rezervacije, Crna Lista, Radnici, Usluge, Podešavanja) accessible to super_admin. Create salon modal still functional.
